requirements.quote: Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that:
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that:

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system. However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system. However, a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends; the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.quote: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends; the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.

requirements.text: This provision shall not apply when direction indicator lamps of categories 2a and 2b are operated as emergency stop signal according to paragraph 6.23.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: This provision shall not apply when direction indicator lamps of categories 2a and 2b are operated as emergency stop signal according to paragraph 6.23.1. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamp(s) used for answer-back signal shall operate according to the conditions specified in general specifications and/or in dedicated paragraph 6.27.
requirements.quote: The lamp(s) used for answer-back signal shall operate according to the conditions specified in general specifications and/or in dedicated paragraph 6.27.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.
requirements.quote: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.

requirements.text: This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

requirements.text: In the event of any failure affecting the operation of the concealment device(s) the lamps shall remain in the position of use, if already in use, or shall be capable of being moved into the position of use without the aid of tools.
requirements.quote: In the event of any failure affecting the operation of the concealment device(s) the lamps shall remain in the position of use, if already in use, or shall be capable of being moved into the position of use without the aid of tools.

requirements.text: It shall be possible to move the lamps into the position of use and to switch them ON by means of a single control, without excluding the possibility of moving them into the position of use without switching them ON. However, in the case of grouped main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps, the control referred to above is required only to activate the dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be possible to move the lamps into the position of use and to switch them ON by means of a single control, without excluding the possibility of moving them into the position of use without switching them ON. However, in the case of grouped main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps, the control referred to above is required only to activate the dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible deliberately, from the driver's seat, to stop the movement of switched ON lamps before they reach the position of use.
requirements.quote: It shall not be possible deliberately, from the driver's seat, to stop the movement of switched ON lamps before they reach the position of use.

requirements.text: When the concealment device has a temperature of -30 °C to +50 °C the headlamps shall be capable of reaching the position of use within three seconds of initial operation of the control.
requirements.quote: When the concealment device has a temperature of -30 °C to +50 °C the headlamps shall be capable of reaching the position of use within three seconds of initial operation of the control.

requirements.text: White 8Also known as white or colourless retro-reflector. 9Nothing in this Regulation shall preclude the Contracting Parties applying this Regulation from allowing the use of white conspicuity markings to the rear in their territories.
requirements.quote: White 8Also known as white or colourless retro-reflector. 9Nothing in this Regulation shall preclude the Contracting Parties applying this Regulation from allowing the use of white conspicuity markings to the rear in their territories.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system either of the following conditions shall apply:
requirements.quote: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system either of the following conditions shall apply:

requirements.text: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: For direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, photometric and colorimetric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or 5.21.2.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or 5.21.2.

requirements.text: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

requirements.text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.
requirements.quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Where an AFS is fitted, it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of dipped-beam headlamps and, if it provides main-beam function(s), it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of main-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: Where an AFS is fitted, it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of dipped-beam headlamps and, if it provides main-beam function(s), it shall be considered equivalent to a pair of main-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.quote: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

requirements.text: However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
requirements.quote: However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions:
requirements.quote: For vehicles of M and N categories the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions:

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: A report shall be attached to the approval documentation describing the methods used to demonstrate compliance and the results obtained.
requirements.quote: A report shall be attached to the approval documentation describing the methods used to demonstrate compliance and the results obtained.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.

requirements.text: The light intensity in any direction does not exceed 0.5 cd;
requirements.quote: The light intensity in any direction does not exceed 0.5 cd;

requirements.text: To verify that this statement is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
requirements.quote: To verify that this statement is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.

requirements.text: The Driver Assistance Projection shall be constituted of patterns, symbols or both.
requirements.quote: The Driver Assistance Projection shall be constituted of patterns, symbols or both.

requirements.text: Symbols and patterns shall be related and limited only to warning/highlighting:
requirements.quote: Symbols and patterns shall be related and limited only to warning/highlighting:

requirements.text: the presence of hazardous traffic situation (b) the presence of other road users which require the driver’s attention (c) to maintain the distances to surrounding road users and infrastructure (d) to maintain the correct lane The patterns and symbols shall be explained in the owner's handbook.
requirements.quote: the presence of hazardous traffic situation (b) the presence of other road users which require the driver’s attention (c) to maintain the distances to surrounding road users and infrastructure (d) to maintain the correct lane The patterns and symbols shall be explained in the owner's handbook.

requirements.text: It shall be always possible to manually deactivate and reactivate the system which operates the Driver Assistant Projection.
requirements.quote: It shall be always possible to manually deactivate and reactivate the system which operates the Driver Assistant Projection.

requirements.text: The projected symbols and patterns shall no longer be projected when their associated underlying conditions allowing them to be shown do not exist anymore.
requirements.quote: The projected symbols and patterns shall no longer be projected when their associated underlying conditions allowing them to be shown do not exist anymore.

requirements.text: The projected symbols and patterns shall stop flashing when their associated underlying conditions allowing them to flash do not exist anymore.
requirements.quote: The projected symbols and patterns shall stop flashing when their associated underlying conditions allowing them to flash do not exist anymore.

requirements.text: The Driver Assistance Projection shall be deactivated automatically in case of an electrically detectable failure of the system that affects the visual information on the road given by the Driver Assistance Projection.
requirements.quote: The Driver Assistance Projection shall be deactivated automatically in case of an electrically detectable failure of the system that affects the visual information on the road given by the Driver Assistance Projection.

requirements.text: The Driver Assistance Projection shall not interfere with information displayed by the Field of Vision Assistant as defined in UN Regulation No. 125.
requirements.quote: The Driver Assistance Projection shall not interfere with information displayed by the Field of Vision Assistant as defined in UN Regulation No. 125.

requirements.text: The Driver Assistance Projection shall not be switched ON when the windshield wiper is switched ON and its continuous operation has occurred for a period of at least two minutes.
requirements.quote: The Driver Assistance Projection shall not be switched ON when the windshield wiper is switched ON and its continuous operation has occurred for a period of at least two minutes.

requirements.text: Except for the wrong way warning, predicted trajectory and risk of collision warning, Driver Assistance Projection shall not be switched ON when the vehicle speed is below 65 km/h. However, when the projection is already switched ON, it may remain switched ON as long as the vehicle speed remains above 40 km/h.
requirements.quote: Except for the wrong way warning, predicted trajectory and risk of collision warning, Driver Assistance Projection shall not be switched ON when the vehicle speed is below 65 km/h. However, when the projection is already switched ON, it may remain switched ON as long as the vehicle speed remains above 40 km/h.

requirements.text: Except for predicted trajectory, the lateral distance from the outer edges of the Driver Assistance Projection with respect to the longitudinal median plane or to the trajectory of the centre of gravity of the vehicle shall not be more than 1,250 mm.
requirements.quote: Except for predicted trajectory, the lateral distance from the outer edges of the Driver Assistance Projection with respect to the longitudinal median plane or to the trajectory of the centre of gravity of the vehicle shall not be more than 1,250 mm.

requirements.text: It shall not be wider than the width of the vehicle including any fitted accessories and trailer if applicable and, in any case, shall not be more than 2,600 mm.

requirements.text: For the following tests, the mass of the passengers shall be calculated on the basis of 75 kg per person.
requirements.quote: For the following tests, the mass of the passengers shall be calculated on the basis of 75 kg per person.

requirements.text: The angle of the light beam of the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following load conditions:
requirements.quote: The angle of the light beam of the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following load conditions:

requirements.text: If the vehicle has a front and a rear boot, the additional load shall be appropriately distributed in order to obtain the permissible axle loads. However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on one of the axles, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached;
requirements.quote: If the vehicle has a front and a rear boot, the additional load shall be appropriately distributed in order to obtain the permissible axle loads. However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on one of the axles, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached;

requirements.text: However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on the axle, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached.
requirements.quote: However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on the axle, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached.

requirements.text: In determining the above loading conditions, account shall be taken of any loading restrictions laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In determining the above loading conditions, account shall be taken of any loading restrictions laid down by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions: 1As defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3.), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3, para. 2 -www.unece.org/trans/main/wp29/wp29wgs/wp29gen/wp29resolutions.html
requirements.quote: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions: 1As defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3.), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3, para. 2 -www.unece.org/trans/main/wp29/wp29wgs/wp29gen/wp29resolutions.html

requirements.text: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions;
requirements.quote: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions;

requirements.text: If a visual inspection of the dipped-beam pattern on the screen or a photometric method is used, measurement shall be carried out in a dark environment (for example, a dark room) of sufficient area to allow the vehicle and the screen to be placed as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: If a visual inspection of the dipped-beam pattern on the screen or a photometric method is used, measurement shall be carried out in a dark environment (for example, a dark room) of sufficient area to allow the vehicle and the screen to be placed as shown in Figure 1.

requirements.text: Headlamp centres of reference shall be at a distance from the screen of at least 10 m.
requirements.quote: Headlamp centres of reference shall be at a distance from the screen of at least 10 m.

requirements.text: The ground on which measurements are made shall be as flat and horizontal as possible, so that the reproducibility of measurements of dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀ 0.5 mrad (±0.05 per cent inclination).
requirements.quote: The ground on which measurements are made shall be as flat and horizontal as possible, so that the reproducibility of measurements of dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀ 0.5 mrad (±0.05 per cent inclination).

requirements.text: If a screen is used, its marking, position and orientation in relation to the ground and to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, shall be such that the reproducibility of the measurement of the dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀0.5 mrad (∀0.05 per cent inclination).
requirements.quote: If a screen is used, its marking, position and orientation in relation to the ground and to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, shall be such that the reproducibility of the measurement of the dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀0.5 mrad (∀0.05 per cent inclination).

requirements.text: During measurements, the ambient temperature shall be between 10 and 30 °C.
requirements.quote: During measurements, the ambient temperature shall be between 10 and 30 °C.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be carried out on a vehicle which has travelled a distance of between 1,000 km and 10,000 km, preferably 5,000 km.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be carried out on a vehicle which has travelled a distance of between 1,000 km and 10,000 km, preferably 5,000 km.

requirements.text: Tyres shall be inflated to the full-load pressure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Tyres shall be inflated to the full-load pressure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be fully replenished (fuel, water, oil) and equipped with all the accessories and tools specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be fully replenished (fuel, water, oil) and equipped with all the accessories and tools specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Full fuel replenishment means that the fuel tank shall be filled to not less than 90 per cent of its capacity.
requirements.quote: Full fuel replenishment means that the fuel tank shall be filled to not less than 90 per cent of its capacity.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have the parking brake released and the gearbox in neutral.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall have the parking brake released and the gearbox in neutral.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be conditioned for at least 8 h at the temperature specified in paragraph 3.4. above.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be conditioned for at least 8 h at the temperature specified in paragraph 3.4. above.

requirements.text: The variations in either dipped-beam or vehicle inclination, depending on the method chosen, shall be measured separately for each side of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The variations in either dipped-beam or vehicle inclination, depending on the method chosen, shall be measured separately for each side of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The results obtained from both left and right headlamps under all the load conditions specified in Annex 5, shall be within the limits set out in paragraph 5.5. below.
requirements.quote: The results obtained from both left and right headlamps under all the load conditions specified in Annex 5, shall be within the limits set out in paragraph 5.5. below.

requirements.text: The load shall be applied gradually without subjecting the vehicle to excessive shocks.
requirements.quote: The load shall be applied gradually without subjecting the vehicle to excessive shocks.

requirements.text: Where an AFS is fitted, the measurements shall be carried out with the AFS in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: Where an AFS is fitted, the measurements shall be carried out with the AFS in its neutral state.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be prepared as specified in paragraph 4. above and laden as specified in Annex 5 (first loading condition of the respective vehicle category).
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be prepared as specified in paragraph 4. above and laden as specified in Annex 5 (first loading condition of the respective vehicle category).

requirements.text: Before each measurement, the vehicle shall be rocked as specified in paragraph 5.4. below.
requirements.quote: Before each measurement, the vehicle shall be rocked as specified in paragraph 5.4. below.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made three times.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made three times.

requirements.text: If none of the three measured results differ by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.
requirements.quote: If none of the three measured results differ by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.

requirements.text: If any measurement differs from the arithmetic mean of the results by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination), a further series of 10 measurements shall be made, the arithmetic mean of which shall constitute the final result.
requirements.quote: If any measurement differs from the arithmetic mean of the results by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination), a further series of 10 measurements shall be made, the arithmetic mean of which shall constitute the final result.

requirements.text: Any method may be used to measure variations of inclination provided that the readings are accurate to within ±0.2 mrad (±0.02 per cent inclination).
requirements.quote: Any method may be used to measure variations of inclination provided that the readings are accurate to within ±0.2 mrad (±0.02 per cent inclination).

requirements.text: The vehicle suspension and any other part likely to affect dipped-beam inclination shall be activated according to the methods described below. However, the technical authorities and manufacturers may jointly propose other methods (either experimental or based upon calculations), especially when the test poses particular problems, provided such calculations are clearly valid.
requirements.quote: The vehicle suspension and any other part likely to affect dipped-beam inclination shall be activated according to the methods described below. However, the technical authorities and manufacturers may jointly propose other methods (either experimental or based upon calculations), especially when the test poses particular problems, provided such calculations are clearly valid.

requirements.text: category vehicles with conventional suspension With the vehicle standing on the measuring site and, if necessary, with the wheels resting on floating platforms (which shall be used if their absence would lead to restriction of the suspension movement likely to affect the results of measurements), rock the vehicle continuously for at least three complete cycles, for each cycle, first the rear and then the front end of the vehicle is pushed down.
requirements.quote: category vehicles with conventional suspension With the vehicle standing on the measuring site and, if necessary, with the wheels resting on floating platforms (which shall be used if their absence would lead to restriction of the suspension movement likely to affect the results of measurements), rock the vehicle continuously for at least three complete cycles, for each cycle, first the rear and then the front end of the vehicle is pushed down.

requirements.text: The rocking sequence shall end with the completion of a cycle.
requirements.quote: The rocking sequence shall end with the completion of a cycle.

requirements.text: Before making the measurements, the vehicle shall be allowed to come to rest spontaneously.
requirements.quote: Before making the measurements, the vehicle shall be allowed to come to rest spontaneously.

requirements.text: The variation of the inclination of the dipped-beam shall be assessed for each of the different loading conditions in relation to the measured initial inclination determined in accordance with paragraph 5.2. above.
requirements.quote: The variation of the inclination of the dipped-beam shall be assessed for each of the different loading conditions in relation to the measured initial inclination determined in accordance with paragraph 5.2. above.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is fitted with a manual headlamp-levelling system, the latter shall be adjusted to the positions specified by the manufacturer for given loading conditions (according to Annex 5).
requirements.quote: If the vehicle is fitted with a manual headlamp-levelling system, the latter shall be adjusted to the positions specified by the manufacturer for given loading conditions (according to Annex 5).

requirements.text: To begin with, a single measurement shall be made in each loading condition.
requirements.quote: To begin with, a single measurement shall be made in each loading condition.

requirements.text: If the result(s) of any measurement(s) does (do) not lie within the safety margin indicated in paragraph 5.5.1. or exceed(s) the limit values, a further three measurements shall be made in the loading conditions corresponding to this (these) result(s) as specified in paragraph 5.5.3.
requirements.quote: If the result(s) of any measurement(s) does (do) not lie within the safety margin indicated in paragraph 5.5.1. or exceed(s) the limit values, a further three measurements shall be made in the loading conditions corresponding to this (these) result(s) as specified in paragraph 5.5.3.

requirements.text: If none of the three measured results differs by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.
requirements.quote: If none of the three measured results differs by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.

requirements.text: If a vehicle is fitted with an automatic headlamp-levelling system which has an inherent hysteresis loop, average results at the top and bottom of the hysteresis loop shall be taken as significant values.
requirements.quote: If a vehicle is fitted with an automatic headlamp-levelling system which has an inherent hysteresis loop, average results at the top and bottom of the hysteresis loop shall be taken as significant values.

requirements.text: All these measurements shall be made in accordance with paragraphs 5.5.3.1. and 5.5.3.2.
requirements.quote: All these measurements shall be made in accordance with paragraphs 5.5.3.1. and 5.5.3.2.

requirements.text: If only one of the calculated upper or lower limits of variation is exceeded, the manufacturer shall be permitted to choose a different value for the stated initial inclination, within the limits specified for approval.
requirements.quote: If only one of the calculated upper or lower limits of variation is exceeded, the manufacturer shall be permitted to choose a different value for the stated initial inclination, within the limits specified for approval.

requirements.text: Inclination of the dipped beam shall in all cases be produced by a simple control, the operation of which is clearly described in the owner’s handbook.
requirements.quote: Inclination of the dipped beam shall in all cases be produced by a simple control, the operation of which is clearly described in the owner’s handbook.

requirements.text: This control shall carry symbol(s) indicating clearly the movements corresponding to the downward and upward inclination of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: This control shall carry symbol(s) indicating clearly the movements corresponding to the downward and upward inclination of the dipped beam.

requirements.quote: Country roads shall comprise sections having two lanes and sections having four or more lanes and shall include junctions, hills and/or slopes, dips and winding roads.

requirements.text: Additionally they shall comprise sections having curves to the left and to the right.

requirements.text: The external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.

requirements.quote: If the vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved under one or more other Regulations, annexed to the Agreement, in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. needs not be repeated; in such a case, the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. above.

requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied.

requirements.quote: In addition, the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.

requirements.quote: (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN and the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.quote: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.

requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3., 4., and 5., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined bonnet top test area and the windscreen test area.

requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3. and 4., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area.

requirements.text: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700.
requirements.quote: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700.

requirements.text: The headform impactors shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 3.
requirements.quote: The headform impactors shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 3.

requirements.text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
requirements.quote: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.

requirements.text: For these tests, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.
requirements.quote: For these tests, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.

requirements.text: In the latter case, the ratio of the head impact vs. the corresponding vehicle velocity shall be 0.9.

requirements.quote: In such cases, ARHSS shall automatically return to the normal ride height when the vehicle speed exceeds 25 km/h or when the system is manually disengaged by the driver.

requirements.quote: The compliance with the conditions of paragraph 5.3.1.1. or 5.3.1.2. shall be demonstrated by the vehicle manufacturer to the satisfaction of the technical service by independent means (e.g. a physical test).

requirements.quote: The exceptional low speed use case of paragraph 5.3.1.2 shall be additionally described in the owner’s handbook.

requirements.quote: As from the official date of entry into force of the 02 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 02 series of amendments.

requirements.quote: As from the official date of entry into force of the 03 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 03 series of amendments.

requirements.quote: As from the official date of entry into force of the 04 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this UN Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type-approvals under this UN Regulation as amended by the 04 series of amendments.

requirements.text: For each test the impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: For each test the impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1.

requirements.text: The size of the sheets shall be within the requirements described in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: The size of the sheets shall be within the requirements described in Figure 1.

requirements.text: The compression characteristics shall be checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin.
requirements.quote: The compression characteristics shall be checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin.

requirements.text: All impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for testing.
requirements.quote: All impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for testing.

requirements.text: After removal from the storage the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.quote: After removal from the storage the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.

requirements.text: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

requirements.text: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ±2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ±2° at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
requirements.quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5° (see Figure 3).
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5° (see Figure 3).

requirements.text: ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
requirements.quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.

requirements.text: For each test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.
requirements.quote: For each test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.

requirements.text: The skin shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.
requirements.quote: The skin shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.

requirements.text: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg (this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member).
requirements.quote: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg (this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member).

requirements.text: The foam and rubber skin shall be folded back towards the rear, with the rubber skin attached via spacers to the rear member so that the sides of the rubber skin are held parallel.
requirements.quote: The foam and rubber skin shall be folded back towards the rear, with the rubber skin attached via spacers to the rear member so that the sides of the rubber skin are held parallel.

requirements.text: The foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.
requirements.quote: The foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.

requirements.text: The test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.
requirements.quote: The test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.

requirements.text: After removal from the storage the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.
requirements.quote: After removal from the storage the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The headform impactors shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 4.6. and 5.6. below) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 4.7. and 5.7. below).
requirements.quote: The headform impactors shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 4.6. and 5.6. below) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 4.7. and 5.7. below).

requirements.text: The impactors shall be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
requirements.quote: The impactors shall be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

requirements.text: The velocity of the headform impactor shall be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976.
requirements.quote: The velocity of the headform impactor shall be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976.

requirements.text: The measured velocity shall be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact.
requirements.quote: The measured velocity shall be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact.

requirements.text: The angle of the velocity vector at the time of impact shall be calculated or measured.
requirements.quote: The angle of the velocity vector at the time of impact shall be calculated or measured.

requirements.text: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated.
requirements.quote: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated.

requirements.text: The measuring point on the front structure of the vehicle shall be recorded.
requirements.quote: The measuring point on the front structure of the vehicle shall be recorded.

requirements.text: Recording of test results shall be in accordance with ISO 6487:2002.
requirements.quote: Recording of test results shall be in accordance with ISO 6487:2002.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report. However, the technical services conducting the tests shall perform as many tests as necessary to guarantee the compliance of the vehicle with the head injury criteria (HIC) limit values of 1,000 for the HIC1000 zone and 1,700 for the HIC1700 zone, especially in the points near to the borders between the two types of zones.
requirements.quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report. However, the technical services conducting the tests shall perform as many tests as necessary to guarantee the compliance of the vehicle with the head injury criteria (HIC) limit values of 1,000 for the HIC1000 zone and 1,700 for the HIC1700 zone, especially in the points near to the borders between the two types of zones.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the child headform impactor over the areas prescribed by the child bonnet top test area and the child windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the child headform impactor over the areas prescribed by the child bonnet top test area and the child windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.
requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the child/small adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the child headform test areas as defined in paragraphs 2.16. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the child/small adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the child headform test areas as defined in paragraphs 2.16. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.
requirements.quote: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.

requirements.text: For the child headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
