requirements.text: The headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 50° ± 2° to the horizontal.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 50° ± 2° to the horizontal.

requirements.text: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.

requirements.text: On request of the technical service the tests may be repeated where the HIC value is below the limit of the head impact zone, for instance in case of underlying structures within 100 mm of the measuring point.
requirements.quote: On request of the technical service the tests may be repeated where the HIC value is below the limit of the head impact zone, for instance in case of underlying structures within 100 mm of the measuring point.

requirements.text: Tests with atypical windscreen fracture shall be duly recorded in the test report.
requirements.quote: Tests with atypical windscreen fracture shall be duly recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be certified using two certification tests as follows:
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be certified using two certification tests as follows:

requirements.text: First, the certification shall be conducted according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex before starting a vehicle test series.
requirements.quote: First, the certification shall be conducted according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex before starting a vehicle test series.

requirements.text: Second, after a maximum of 10 vehicle tests, certification should be conducted according to the pendulum certification (PC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.3. of this annex. Ongoing certification testing then shall constitute the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification.
requirements.quote: Second, after a maximum of 10 vehicle tests, certification should be conducted according to the pendulum certification (PC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.3. of this annex. Ongoing certification testing then shall constitute the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification.

requirements.text: In addition, the impactor shall be certified according to the procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. below at least once a year.
requirements.quote: In addition, the impactor shall be certified according to the procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. below at least once a year.

requirements.text: The femur and the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex when tested according to paragraph 1.2.4. of this annex. The knee joint of the lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.3. of this annex when tested according to paragraph 1.2.5 of this annex. The stabilized temperature of the impactor during the certification tests shall be 20 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The femur and the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.2. of this annex when tested according to paragraph 1.2.4. of this annex. The knee joint of the lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 1.2.3. of this annex when tested according to paragraph 1.2.5 of this annex. The stabilized temperature of the impactor during the certification tests shall be 20 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.text: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load.
requirements.quote: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load.

requirements.text: When the femur and the tibia of the impactor are loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.4. below, the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: When the femur and the tibia of the impactor are loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.4. below, the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 1.

requirements.text: When the knee joint of the impactor is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.5. of this annex, the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 2.
requirements.quote: When the knee joint of the impactor is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 1.2.5. of this annex, the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 2.

requirements.text: The edges of the femur and tibia, not bending parts, shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 3 and Figure 4.
requirements.quote: The edges of the femur and tibia, not bending parts, shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 3 and Figure 4.

requirements.text: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180° ± 2° tolerance.
requirements.quote: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180° ± 2° tolerance.

requirements.text: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis.
requirements.quote: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis.

requirements.text: The force shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm.
requirements.quote: The force shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm.

requirements.text: The ends of the knee joint shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 5.
requirements.quote: The ends of the knee joint shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 5.

requirements.text: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within ±2° tolerance.
requirements.quote: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within ±2° tolerance.

requirements.text: To avoid impactor damage, a neoprene sheet shall be set underneath the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint which is described in the Figure 3 of Annex 4 shall be removed.
requirements.quote: To avoid impactor damage, a neoprene sheet shall be set underneath the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint which is described in the Figure 3 of Annex 4 shall be removed.

requirements.text: The neoprene sheet used in this test shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2 (b) of Annex 5.
requirements.quote: The neoprene sheet used in this test shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2 (b) of Annex 5.

requirements.text: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the knee joint center within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis (see Figure 5 below).
requirements.quote: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the knee joint center within ±2 mm tolerance along the Z-axis (see Figure 5 below).

requirements.text: The external load shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm.
requirements.quote: The external load shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm.

requirements.text: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C during the test.
requirements.quote: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C during the test.

requirements.text: The temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification and recorded in a certification report.
requirements.quote: The temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification and recorded in a certification report.

requirements.text: Tibia-1 shall be 235 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-1 shall be 235 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-2 shall be 187 Nm ≤ 219 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-2 shall be 187 Nm ≤ 219 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.
requirements.quote: Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.

requirements.text: MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm;
requirements.quote: MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm;

requirements.text: ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm;
requirements.quote: ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm;

requirements.text: PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.
requirements.quote: PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.

requirements.text: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.
requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.
requirements.quote: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.

requirements.text: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 400 Nm for the tibia bending moments.
requirements.quote: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 400 Nm for the tibia bending moments.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor, including the flesh and skin, shall be suspended from the dynamic certification test rig 15° ± 1° upward from the horizontal as shown in Figure 6 below.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor, including the flesh and skin, shall be suspended from the dynamic certification test rig 15° ± 1° upward from the horizontal as shown in Figure 6 below.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be released from the suspended position and fall freely against the pin joint of the test rig as shown in Figure 6.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be released from the suspended position and fall freely against the pin joint of the test rig as shown in Figure 6.

requirements.text: The knee joint centre of the impactor shall be 30 mm ± 1 mm below the bottom line of the stopper bar, and the tibia impact face without the flesh and skin shall be located 13 mm ± 2 mm from the front upper edge of the stopper bar when the impactor is hanging freely as shown in Figure 6 below.
requirements.quote: The knee joint centre of the impactor shall be 30 mm ± 1 mm below the bottom line of the stopper bar, and the tibia impact face without the flesh and skin shall be located 13 mm ± 2 mm from the front upper edge of the stopper bar when the impactor is hanging freely as shown in Figure 6 below.

requirements.text: Tibia-1 shall be 230 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-1 shall be 230 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-2 shall be 210 Nm ≤ 252 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-2 shall be 210 Nm ≤ 252 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-3 shall be 166 Nm ≤ 192 Nm;
requirements.quote: Tibia-3 shall be 166 Nm ≤ 192 Nm;

requirements.text: Tibia-4 shall be 93 Nm ≤ 108 Nm.
requirements.quote: Tibia-4 shall be 93 Nm ≤ 108 Nm.

requirements.text: MCL shall be 17.0 ≤ 21.0 mm;
requirements.quote: MCL shall be 17.0 ≤ 21.0 mm;

requirements.text: ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.0 mm;
requirements.quote: ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.0 mm;

requirements.text: PCL shall be 4.0 mm ≤ 6.0 mm.
requirements.quote: PCL shall be 4.0 mm ≤ 6.0 mm.

requirements.text: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 50 ms after the impact timing.
requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 50 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: The assembled flexible lower legform impactor (with the flesh and skin) shall be hung vertically and freely suspended from a test rig as shown in Figure 7 below.
requirements.quote: The assembled flexible lower legform impactor (with the flesh and skin) shall be hung vertically and freely suspended from a test rig as shown in Figure 7 below.

requirements.text: The legform shall achieve a free flight condition within 10 ms after the time of first contact of the honeycomb impactor.
requirements.quote: The legform shall achieve a free flight condition within 10 ms after the time of first contact of the honeycomb impactor.

requirements.text: The honeycomb of 5052 alloy, which is attached in front of the moving ram, shall be 200 mm ± 5 mm wide, 160 mm ± 5 mm high and 60 mm ± 2 mm deep and shall have a crush strength of 75 pound per square inch (psi) ±10 per cent.
requirements.quote: The honeycomb of 5052 alloy, which is attached in front of the moving ram, shall be 200 mm ± 5 mm wide, 160 mm ± 5 mm high and 60 mm ± 2 mm deep and shall have a crush strength of 75 pound per square inch (psi) ±10 per cent.

requirements.text: The upper edge of the honeycomb face shall be in line with the rigid plate of the linearly guided impactor.
requirements.quote: The upper edge of the honeycomb face shall be in line with the rigid plate of the linearly guided impactor.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the upper edge of the honeycomb shall be in line with the knee joint centre line within a vertical tolerance of ±2 mm.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact, the upper edge of the honeycomb shall be in line with the knee joint centre line within a vertical tolerance of ±2 mm.

requirements.text: The honeycomb shall not be deformed before the impact test.
requirements.quote: The honeycomb shall not be deformed before the impact test.

requirements.text: At the time of the first contact, the flexible lower legform impactor pitch angle (rotation around the Y-axis) and therefore the pitch angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the lateral vertical plane.
requirements.quote: At the time of the first contact, the flexible lower legform impactor pitch angle (rotation around the Y-axis) and therefore the pitch angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the lateral vertical plane.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor roll angle (rotation around the X-axis) and therefore the roll angle of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the longitudinal vertical plane.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor roll angle (rotation around the X-axis) and therefore the roll angle of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the longitudinal vertical plane.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor yaw angle (rotation around the Z-axis) and therefore the yaw angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2°.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor yaw angle (rotation around the Z-axis) and therefore the yaw angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2°.

requirements.text: The impactor shall also be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall also be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.

requirements.text: The foam flesh for the test impactor shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification.
requirements.quote: The foam flesh for the test impactor shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification.

requirements.text: The test impactor itself shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact.
requirements.quote: The test impactor itself shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact.

requirements.text: The temperature tolerances for the test impactor shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.
requirements.quote: The temperature tolerances for the test impactor shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.

requirements.text: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C during certification.
requirements.quote: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C during certification.

requirements.text: Each certification shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be calibrated is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Each certification shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be calibrated is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: The relative humidity and temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification, and recorded in the certification report.
requirements.quote: The relative humidity and temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification, and recorded in the certification report.

requirements.text: When the impactor is propelled into a stationary cylindrical pendulum the peak force measured in each load transducer shall be not less than 1.20 kN and not more than 1.55 kN and the difference between the peak forces measured in the top and bottom load transducers shall not be more than 0.10 kN.
requirements.quote: When the impactor is propelled into a stationary cylindrical pendulum the peak force measured in each load transducer shall be not less than 1.20 kN and not more than 1.55 kN and the difference between the peak forces measured in the top and bottom load transducers shall not be more than 0.10 kN.

requirements.text: Also, the peak bending moment measured by the strain gauges shall not be less than 190 Nm and not more than 250 Nm on the centre position and not less than 160 Nm and not more than 220 Nm for the outer positions.
requirements.quote: Also, the peak bending moment measured by the strain gauges shall not be less than 190 Nm and not more than 250 Nm on the centre position and not less than 160 Nm and not more than 220 Nm for the outer positions.

requirements.text: The difference between the upper and lower peak bending moments shall not be more than 20 Nm.
requirements.quote: The difference between the upper and lower peak bending moments shall not be more than 20 Nm.

requirements.text: For all these values, the readings used shall be from the initial impact with the pendulum and not from the arresting phase.
requirements.quote: For all these values, the readings used shall be from the initial impact with the pendulum and not from the arresting phase.

requirements.text: Any system used to arrest the impactor or pendulum shall be so arranged that the arresting phase does not overlap in time with the initial impact.
requirements.quote: Any system used to arrest the impactor or pendulum shall be so arranged that the arresting phase does not overlap in time with the initial impact.

requirements.text: The arresting system shall not cause the transducer outputs to exceed the specified CAC.
requirements.quote: The arresting system shall not cause the transducer outputs to exceed the specified CAC.

requirements.text: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 10 kN for the force transducers and 1,000 Nm for the bending moment measurements.
requirements.quote: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 10 kN for the force transducers and 1,000 Nm for the bending moment measurements.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be mounted to the propulsion and guidance system, by a torque limiting joint.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be mounted to the propulsion and guidance system, by a torque limiting joint.

requirements.text: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is perpendicular to the axis of the guidance system, with a tolerance of ±2°, with the joint friction torque set to 675 Nm ± 25 Nm.
requirements.quote: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is perpendicular to the axis of the guidance system, with a tolerance of ±2°, with the joint friction torque set to 675 Nm ± 25 Nm.

requirements.text: The guidance system shall be fitted with low friction guides that allow the impactor to move only in the specified direction of impact, when in contact with the pendulum.
requirements.quote: The guidance system shall be fitted with low friction guides that allow the impactor to move only in the specified direction of impact, when in contact with the pendulum.

requirements.text: The impactor mass shall be adjusted to give a mass of 12 kg ± 0.1 kg, this mass includes those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during impact.
requirements.quote: The impactor mass shall be adjusted to give a mass of 12 kg ± 0.1 kg, this mass includes those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during impact.

requirements.text: The centre of gravity of those parts of the impactor which are effectively forward of the torque limiting joint, including the extra masses fitted, shall lie on the longitudinal centreline of the impactor, with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: The centre of gravity of those parts of the impactor which are effectively forward of the torque limiting joint, including the extra masses fitted, shall lie on the longitudinal centreline of the impactor, with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be certified with previously unused foam.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be certified with previously unused foam.

requirements.text: The impactor foam shall not be excessively handled or deformed before, during or after fitting.
requirements.quote: The impactor foam shall not be excessively handled or deformed before, during or after fitting.

requirements.text: The impactor with the front member vertical shall be propelled horizontally at a velocity of 7.1 m/s ± 0.1 m/s into the stationary pendulum as shown in Figure 8.
requirements.quote: The impactor with the front member vertical shall be propelled horizontally at a velocity of 7.1 m/s ± 0.1 m/s into the stationary pendulum as shown in Figure 8.

requirements.text: The pendulum tube shall have a mass of 3 kg ± 0.03 kg, a wall thickness of 3 mm ± 0.15 mm and an outside diameter of 150 mm +1 mm/-4 mm.
requirements.quote: The pendulum tube shall have a mass of 3 kg ± 0.03 kg, a wall thickness of 3 mm ± 0.15 mm and an outside diameter of 150 mm +1 mm/-4 mm.

requirements.text: Total pendulum tube length shall be 275 mm ± 25 mm.
requirements.quote: Total pendulum tube length shall be 275 mm ± 25 mm.

requirements.text: The pendulum tube shall be made from cold finished seamless steel (metal surface plating is permissible for protection from corrosion), with an outer surface finish of better than 2.0 micrometer.
requirements.quote: The pendulum tube shall be made from cold finished seamless steel (metal surface plating is permissible for protection from corrosion), with an outer surface finish of better than 2.0 micrometer.

requirements.text: It shall be suspended on two wire ropes of 1.5 mm ± 0.2 mm diameter and of 2.0 m minimum length.
requirements.quote: It shall be suspended on two wire ropes of 1.5 mm ± 0.2 mm diameter and of 2.0 m minimum length.

requirements.text: The surface of the pendulum shall be clean and dry.
requirements.quote: The surface of the pendulum shall be clean and dry.

requirements.text: The pendulum tube shall be positioned so that the longitudinal axis of the cylinder is perpendicular to the front member (i.e. level), with a tolerance of ±2℃, and to the direction of impactor motion, with a tolerance of ±2℃, and with the centre of the pendulum tube aligned with the centre of the impactor front member, with tolerances of ±5 mm laterally and ±5 mm vertically.
requirements.quote: The pendulum tube shall be positioned so that the longitudinal axis of the cylinder is perpendicular to the front member (i.e. level), with a tolerance of ±2℃, and to the direction of impactor motion, with a tolerance of ±2℃, and with the centre of the pendulum tube aligned with the centre of the impactor front member, with tolerances of ±5 mm laterally and ±5 mm vertically.

requirements.text: The impactors shall be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if the transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.
requirements.quote: The impactors shall be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if the transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.

requirements.text: When the headform impactors are dropped from a height of 376 mm ± 1 mm in accordance with paragraph 3.3. below, the peak resultant acceleration measured by one triaxial (or three uniaxial) accelerometer (accelerometers) in the headform impactor shall be:
requirements.quote: When the headform impactors are dropped from a height of 376 mm ± 1 mm in accordance with paragraph 3.3. below, the peak resultant acceleration measured by one triaxial (or three uniaxial) accelerometer (accelerometers) in the headform impactor shall be:

requirements.text: The acceleration time curve shall be uni-modal.
requirements.quote: The acceleration time curve shall be uni-modal.

requirements.text: The instrumentation response values CFC and CAC for each accelerometer shall be 1,000 Hz and 500 g respectively as defined in ISO 6487:2002.
requirements.quote: The instrumentation response values CFC and CAC for each accelerometer shall be 1,000 Hz and 500 g respectively as defined in ISO 6487:2002.

requirements.text: The headform impactors shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact.
requirements.quote: The headform impactors shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact.

requirements.text: The temperature tolerances shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.
requirements.quote: The temperature tolerances shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.

requirements.text: The headform impactor shall be suspended from a drop rig as shown in Figure 9.
requirements.quote: The headform impactor shall be suspended from a drop rig as shown in Figure 9.

requirements.text: The headform impactor shall be dropped from the specified height by means that ensure instant release onto a rigidly supported flat horizontal steel plate, over 50 mm thick and over 300 mm x 300 mm square which has a clean dry surface and a surface finish of between 0.2 and 2.0 micrometer.
requirements.quote: The headform impactor shall be dropped from the specified height by means that ensure instant release onto a rigidly supported flat horizontal steel plate, over 50 mm thick and over 300 mm x 300 mm square which has a clean dry surface and a surface finish of between 0.2 and 2.0 micrometer.

requirements.text: The headform impactor shall be dropped with the rear face of the impactor at the test angle specified in Annex 5, paragraph 4.7. for the child headform impactor and in Annex 5, paragraph 5.7. for the adult headform impactor with respect to the vertical as shown in Figure 9 below.
requirements.quote: The headform impactor shall be dropped with the rear face of the impactor at the test angle specified in Annex 5, paragraph 4.7. for the child headform impactor and in Annex 5, paragraph 5.7. for the adult headform impactor with respect to the vertical as shown in Figure 9 below.

requirements.text: The suspension of the headform impactor shall be such that it does not rotate during the fall.
requirements.quote: The suspension of the headform impactor shall be such that it does not rotate during the fall.

requirements.text: The drop test shall be performed three times, with the headform impactor rotated 120° around its symmetrical axis after each test.
requirements.quote: The drop test shall be performed three times, with the headform impactor rotated 120° around its symmetrical axis after each test.
